title: Terrible experience.
body:
The app advertises that transfers can be completed quickly and easily, but that has not been my experience. The transfer I made gets stuck in a pending state, and the recipient receives no notification that a transfer has even been initiated.
When I try to cancel the transfer, the process freezes and nothing happens. It is impossible to tell whether the cancellation has actually been processed.
Customer support is equally frustrating. The chat service repeatedly directs me to automated bots that cannot resolve the issue. It then puts you onto a human agent which feels like an eternity, then the keyboard disappears within the chat, making it impossible to type a response. The agent is then left waiting, while I have no way of communicating.
The entire experience has been stressful, time-consuming, and unacceptable.

title: Worst business and app on the planet
body: The fact that a company is even allowed to operate this way is proof that humanity isn't going to make it. They are the most exploitative, greedy scam business that has ever existed. They withhold huge batches of tickets on purpose to fabricate urgency, then if you buy platinum tickets (aka surge pricing) and only realize you got ripped off after the fact, you are literally screwed. If you try to sell them at the lowest price possible, they will still add on more fees which makes your tickets too uncompetitive to sell. But the craziest part is they won't even let you sell your tickets at a loss. You can't just lower the price until you are eating those extra fees, no THERE IS A MINIMUM PRICE YOU CAN SELL THEM AT WHICH MEANS YOU ARE STUCK WITH THEM aka if you can't go to the concert now you are taking a 100% loss. Then right before the concert they will flood it with all of those cheaper seats they withheld, making it impossible to sell your tickets even if you DIDN'T buy them with surge pricing. title: I do not recommend Uber
body:
Want terrible service? Want to be charged multiple times for a ride that happened over a month ago? Want customer support to tell you that you are wrong instead of actually investigating the problem? Then use Uber.

This is not the first time I’ve had issues with this service, and this situation has left me extremely disappointed and frustrated.

Uber charged me again for a ride that happened more than a month ago and was already paid for. The most frustrating part is that this “new” ride never happened. It does not exist in my Uber account, and I have no way to delete trips from my account. Uber knows this, yet their support team continues to insist that I am wrong instead of looking at the facts.

I provided proof from both my Uber account and my bank showing that the original payment was already completed. My account clearly shows that I had no rides for over a month, except for one completely different trip yesterday.

Instead of helping resolve a clear duplicate charge, customer support treated me as if I didn’t understand my own account and my own transactions.

I do not recommend Uber. This has been one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had with a transportation

title: Discriminatory app for those with a companion card
body:
Where to start… I needed to book 5 tickets, 2 of which were companion card tickets as my two children have disabilities. Firstly, the app does not allow you to purchase “companion card” tickets. I referred to the website and the phone number for “Accessible” tickets. No one answers the phone, for two weeks I tried phoning and all I got was a voice message saying to try again another time. I emailed a request and received advice that someone would contact me within 24hours. Two weeks later and I have only just spoken with someone about this. When dealing with someone over the phone (finally) I was advised that they cannot book the ticket insurance, you can only book this online (but can’t book companion tickets online). The only solution they had was to book 5 normal tickets, email them and request a transfer to 2 companion tickets and they will issue a refund. I am anxious about this approach given how useless TicketMaster has been, but don’t have a choice. I hope they are able to process this change and refund as easily as they say they can. 
If you can, AVOID Ticketmaster at all costs! Ticketek is so much better, never had a problem booking companion tickets with them!!

title: Hosting experience keeps getting worse
body:
I’ve been an Airbnb host for 8 years, and the hosting experience has deteriorated dramatically over the past 6–12 months. Basic functions like nightly rate management, discounts, calendar pricing, and pricing research have become confusing and frustrating. Some “try this new feature” popups keep triggering over and over multiple times per session blocking my workflow. 

Pricing and market context that used to make decisions quick and easy now seems gone, or maybe buried somewhere. Just far less useful. 

I shouldn’t need multiple third-party tools just to efficiently manage pricing. 

“Smart pricing” feature has always been a failed experiment. 

It takes about 7 or 8 taps just to set up a custom promotion or adjust pricing for conditions. 

There’s no way to audit how guests see and interact with check-in instructions or to send them a link direct in chat or text. 

For a company known for great UX and increasingly focused on AI, I expected hosting to become simpler and smarter. Now it’s just more complicated, less transparent, and more time-consuming.

I used to admire this company as an example of great mobile app development. Not any longer.

When the premium option came out, there were actually elements that were premium worthy. Over time, the free option were slowly added to premium. body: Canva is great for short-form social media content but terrible for editing longer videos, it’s honestly the most frustrating video editing app I’ve ever used. It’s ridiculously slow, glitchy and lags constantly even when doing it on a laptop in google chrome. The clips either stop playing completely or stay stuck in the video in playback when they’re not supposed to, and sometimes the audio goes mute for no reason. Think I’ll stick to CapCut for normal YouTube video editing

title: Too many glitches
body:
I used to use Canva daily for making social media posts for my businesses. Recently I’ve found the app to be incredibly frustrating. 
I’m unable to stagger text on a timeline which I used to do with ease. Every time I use the app now I have to select ‘show text timelines’ when it used to come up automatically, but it still won’t stagger the text without it overlaying all the other text.
When I add a text box and want to reply the video it won’t play from the beginning, it will only jump to the last part of the clip.
I’ve gone through forums and support and have no resolution to this issue. App has been updated, cache has been cleared, all steps have been followed. 
I’ve spent over an hour trying to troubleshoot something I do in 30 seconds in instagram editing. Sorry Canva but I will have to cancel my pro subscription if this stays the same.

I am a long-time user, but in the last couple of months the app has started glitching and crashing whenever I use it in my car. And in my car is the main time i want to use the app. I will cancel my family plan at year end if they don't fix this bug.
